# Local React/JSX runtime

This folder contains unmodified local distribution builds used only for
administrator-authored portfolio templates:

- React 18.3.1 — MIT License, https://github.com/facebook/react
- React DOM 18.3.1 — MIT License, https://github.com/facebook/react
- Babel Standalone 7.26.3 — MIT License, https://github.com/babel/babel

They are served locally so custom React templates do not rely on a third-party
runtime CDN.
